subject: Request: Exceptional hosted-API usage price adjustment for OpsWell ramp
messages:
From: Jennifer Park <jennifer@opswell.ai>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@opswell.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pricing for ramp — request for deeper usage rebate

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — the team is excited about Redwood’s latency and cost controls. We ran the numbers and are planning a phased rollout for our inference features across three product modules, which will push monthly tokens well past our initial commitment in Q2.

Quick ask from procurement: to make this ramp financially viable OpsWell needs a deeper rebate in the first six months (we're looking at a 25% effective reduction on hosted-API per-token rates for the initial ramp period). In return we can commit to a 12-month consumption baseline and provide an accelerated onboarding pilot.

I attached our forecast and the procurement requirements. Can your team confirm whether a concession at that level is something Redwood can approve, and if not, what alternatives (ramp credits, volume tranches, or shorter-term pilot credits) you can offer?

We want to move quickly — legal is ready to start MSA review as soon as pricing is confirmed.

Thanks,

Jennifer Park
Head of Platform Partnerships
OpsWell, Inc.

Attachments: opswell_usage_forecast_q1-q3.xlsx; opswell_security_questionnaire_answers.docx

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: Jennifer Park <jennifer@opswell.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing for ramp — request for deeper usage rebate

Hi Jennifer — thanks for the forecast and for laying out the commitment. I’ve reviewed the numbers and this is a strategic account for us given their vertical fit and multi-product expansion plan.

Two immediate notes:
- We typically cap deep concessions for new customers at ~20% without senior approval.
- We can offer structured ramp credits or a time-boxed 25% rebate with upfront conditions (minimum 12-month baseline and an SLA addendum plus a staged commit).

I’m going to escalate to deal desk and loop in Sales Ops and Legal. Can you confirm the earliest date OpsWell needs a signed MSA? That will help us align any time-limited concession.

Best,

Irene Choi
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:46:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: OpsWell — ask: 25% rebate first 6 months (needs exec sign-off)

Marissa / Ben — forwarding OpsWell’s ask (attached forecast + MSA draft). Summary below: 

- Customer: OpsWell, platform company, target ramp across three modules.
- Ask: 25% effective reduction on hosted-API token price for first six months to make ramp economics work.
- Commitment offered: 12-month baseline (detailed in attachment) + pilot onboarding assistance and case study willingness.
- Risk: material unit price erosion in early months; but high expansion potential and strategic positioning in vertical.

Suggested concession framework (what I want to propose if we get senior sign-off):
1) Approve a 25% rebate for months 1–6 only, converted to a one-time onboarding credit applied to usage invoices, not a permanent rate change.
2) Require a signed 12-month consumption baseline and deposit/advance commitment equal to 1 month of forecasted usage at list price.
3) Add SLA clause to MSA for uptime and regional routing plus a performance review at month 4 with options to step down rebate to 15% if usage underperforms >20% of forecast.

Attachments: proposed_msa_v2.pdf; opswell_usage_forecast_q1-q3.xlsx

Can you confirm whether we have latitude to approve that framework? If yes I’ll prepare a short exec memo and DocuSign-ready MSA.

Thanks — Irene

---- Forwarded message from Jennifer Park <jennifer@opswell.ai> ----
> See original attachments (forecast + procurement note).

From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OpsWell — ask: 25% rebate first 6 months (needs exec sign-off)

Team — reviewed the ask and the proposed guardrails. I approve an exception consistent with the framework Irene outlined with the following binding conditions: 

1) Concession: 25% rebate for months 1–6 applied as a credit to invoices (not a new rate card).
2) Commercial guardrails: signed 12-month baseline commitment and an upfront payment equal to one month at list.
3) Legal/Finance: close MSA with the SLA addendum and a clause that automatically reduces the rebate to 15% if actual usage < 80% of the forecasted committed ramp by the end of month 4.
4) Reporting: OpsWell must send weekly ramp telemetry (token consumption broken down by module) for the first 12 weeks.
5) Executive review: Sales/Finance to review final numbers at 90 days; any extension beyond month 6 requires formal renewal request to me.

Irene — please prepare DocuSign with these terms and ensure Legal applies the SLA/measurement language. Ben/Marissa — confirm Finance can accept the proposed upfront payment and the credit application flow.

I’ll sign the approval email once Finance confirms the bookkeeping mechanics.

-Mina
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
